{"consolidated_memory":"MEMORY BLOWUP IN graph/store/adjacency.rs — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Component: graph/store/adjacency.rs (graph engine side)
Common signal across both: resident memory climbing with every batch
Common repro: load the dense neighbourhood fixture
Common stack: Rust module test block in graph/store/adjacency.rs

---

INCIDENT 1: [2026-04-28] Serialiser dropping unknown fields

Trigger: Only manifested after the client had already retried once
Root cause: The serialiser was dropping fields it did not know
Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
Implementation: PR #1836 on branch fix/memory-blowup-1
Outcome: Memory settled at 401 MB instead of climbing past 6 GB

---

INCIDENT 2: [2026-05-27] N+1 query behind lazy relation

Trigger: Only manifested when the input list came in empty
Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
Implementation: PR #4924 on branch fix/memory-blowup-2
Outcome: Backlog cleared 90 minutes after the deploy"}
